g.text: The timeless dawn recitation by Birendra Krishna Bhadra broadcast across Bengal since 1931 on All India Radio.
Sacred Sanskrit Chandi Mahatmya, script by Bani Kumar, and musical direction by
Pankaj Kumar Mullick awakening Bengal for over 90 years.
First broadcast live at 4:00 AM on the dawn of Mahalaya in 1931 from the 1, Garstin Place studio of All India Radio Kolkata.
Even after nine decades, Bengal awakens at dawn on Mahalaya to the resonant voice of Birendra Krishna Bhadra reciting the Chandi Mahatmya.
Explore pandals, plan walking routes, check metro connectivity, and celebrate Bengal.
